title: Change details on a general construction induction card or traffic control training work card
summary: You can update your address or contact details for your white card or traffic control work card online, but you must complete a separate application if your name has changed.
intro:
If your address or contact details have changed, you can update these cards online:

If you've changed your name, you need to complete a SafeWork NSW Change of details application.
who_can_apply: Must have changed address or contact details.
what_you_need: Card number (to change address or contact details online).
Australian marriage certificate or Australian change of name certificate (if changing name).
Certified copy of an Australian marriage certificate or Australian change of name certificate (if changing name).

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to update your details.

internal_links.text: Add your digital white card to the Service NSW app
Apply for a general construction induction card (white card)

faqs.q: How do I update my address or contact details?
faqs.a: You can update your address or contact details online.

faqs.q: What do I do if my name has changed?
faqs.a: If you have changed your name, you need to complete a SafeWork NSW Change of details application.

faqs.q: How can I check my card number and details?
faqs.a: You can check your card number and details by visiting Verify NSW.
